column1: # Hub flash layout for the ESP32-S3 N16R8 board (16 MB).
# Two app slots (ota_0 / ota_1) so the hub can later update itself over Wi-Fi.
# Same two LittleFS partitions as the 4 MB board:
#   userdata  settings.json + history.jsonl   never touched by `uploadfs`
#   spiffs    the web UI (data/www)           rewritten by `uploadfs`
# PlatformIO's `uploadfs` writes the LAST filesystem partition in this table
